        shape = (len(first), len(first[0]))
        pair_rows = list(zip(first, second))
        # Preserve the common color as the field color; mark aligned coincidences.
        colors1 = {x for row in first for x in row}
        colors2 = {x for row in second for x in row}
        common = next(iter(colors1 & colors2))
        return [[3 if a == common and b == common else common for a, b in zip(r1, r2)] for r1, r2 in pair_rows]
    first = [row[:col_cut] for row in grid]
